notes.title: New Content & Sale!
notes.content:
[b]6th Month Anniversary Sale![/b]
Starting Saturday May 25.

Also for the old timers, [b]New Content[/b]:
Introducing new mode: [b]SwapOut![/b]  - Play as/against any playable faction in campaign style missions. 

In accordance with this, much of the Coalition Faction has been reworked including, 
New Super Weapons - Rewired Fuel Tanks, Acid Rain, Deploy Mining Saw, Desolation of Smog
Dual Resource Economy System
Desolator Unit - New 'Drag Bombs' and 'SmackShot' Abilities
New Waste Plant structure - Convert your resources into pollution that empowers your Super weapons.
And more.

There are a number of other changes to upgrades and units that can all be viewed in the in game patch notes.
